The project aims to make astronomy and space science more accessible by transforming complex astronomical concepts into an engaging exploration experience. Users can discover celestial objects, explore galaxies, stars, nebulae, and learn about infrared astronomy through a simple and intuitive interface. details:
Universe Unlocked is an interactive educational astronomy platform inspired by the Planet-X SPHEREx challenge. The project is designed to make space science easier to understand by transforming complex astronomical concepts into an engaging exploration experience.

The platform provides users with multiple ways to explore the universe. Through the Explore Objects section, users can discover celestial objects such as galaxies, stars, and nebulae. The Discover the Cosmos section introduces broader astronomical concepts, helping users learn about galaxies, planets, stellar evolution, infrared astronomy, and the building blocks of life in a simplified manner.

One of the primary goals of the project is to bridge the gap between scientific research and public understanding. Many astronomy datasets and observations contain valuable information but can be difficult for students, beginners, and non-specialists to interpret. Universe Unlocked aims to provide a more intuitive and beginner-friendly way of exploring these concepts.

The current prototype includes:

  • Interactive homepage
  • Explore Objects module
  • Discover the Cosmos module
  • Multi-page navigation system
  • Responsive web design
  • Public GitHub repository and live deployment

Future development plans include:

  • Integration of SPHEREx-inspired resources and datasets
  • Interactive infrared visualizations
  • Detailed celestial object pages
  • AI-powered educational explanations
  • Search and filtering capabilities
  • Interactive sky maps and educational tools

The project was developed using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, GitHub, and GitHub Pages.
